messages.subject: Lunchtime seminar: Building Safety Act 2022 - what real estate teams need to know
messages.plaintextBody:
Join us on Wednesday 24 September, 12:30-13:30 in the Bishopsgate training suite (lunch provided), for a practical update on the Building Safety Act 2022 and its impact on commercial acquisitions and remediation liabilities. 1 hour CPD. External speaker: counsel from Eldon Chambers.

Register via the intranet. Places are limited.

Knowledge & Learning
